judgments.reason: The model text never articulates the proposed mechanism that the three-coin commission is included before payment or that bids above available coins can win; no evidence in the articulation links commission ordering to overbidding.

The model comments about locking an early tie-break but does not state the mechanism that waiting reveals already-committed sealed rival bid values before you commit; it therefore did not articulate the turn-order information advantage.
The model never proposes or explains that 'close' settles the game early with unsold lots nor links any observed early settlement to a rule discrepancy.

Although the trace shows a discrepancy (catalog buy triggered a 3-coin commission), the model only says it will test whether purchases affect standings and does not articulate the mechanism that catalog purchases receive the auction commission, so no correct hypothesis or discovery was demonstrated.
